content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "Ontario has removed the three-month wait, so there is no waiting period and eligible people are covered immediately once they qualify [s04-c500-000]. To qualify you must spend at least 153 days of every 12-month period physically in Ontario [s04-c500-000]. You also need to be in Ontario for 153 of your first 183 days after you become a resident [s04-c500-000]."}
